methodology: Milestones are included only when a repository, release, paper, registry decision, or other public primary record supports the wording. Repository creation proves that a repository entered the GitHub record; it does not by itself prove a product launch. Date precision is stated for every entry.

entries.title: The earliest surviving Elixpo project record
entries.description: The OctaBit repository is the earliest surviving public project record now held by Elixpo. It documents the college-era hardware work that predates the GitHub organization and supports the statement that Elixpo has been building in public since 2023.

entries.title: The Elixpo GitHub organization is created
entries.description: A shared organization gives the growing project series a durable public home. This is the beginning of the organization record, distinct from the earlier college projects that were later gathered under it.

entries.title: The Chapter repository begins preserving shared work
entries.description: The elixpo_chapter repository becomes the master collection for project history and cross-project contributions. It later supplies the evidence base used for contributor recognition across the organization.

entries.title: A versioned Chapter release is published
entries.description: Elixpo Chrome Extension 5.0 is published from the Chapter repository. It remains an early example of the organization recording a concrete public release instead of treating repository activity as the outcome by itself.

entries.title: OctaBit becomes a published research record
entries.description: The RISC-style eight-bit breadboard computer is documented in a journal paper alongside its public implementation, schematics, component notes, and EEPROM tooling. The portal records the paper's stated venue without implying an independently verified peer-review process.

entries.title: Public services and shared infrastructure enter the organization record
entries.description: Repositories for LixBlogs, LixSketch, member portfolios, Accounts, Lixrl, Oreo, Payouts, mail, administration, and service status are added to the organization. Their creation dates verify when they entered this record, not necessarily when every underlying project first began.

entries.title: OreoLook publishes its caching architecture
entries.description: The OreoLook research record connects an arXiv preprint on three-layer caching, the operated answer engine, an interactive Hugging Face Space, and a released evaluation dataset while keeping the limits of reproducibility explicit.

entries.title: Reproducible research becomes a first-class public surface
entries.description: QFabric and MonoDiffuse publish technical records with code, artifacts, methods, limitations, citation information, and documented reproduction paths. They establish the standard expected from research presented through Elixpo.

entries.title: Elixpo adopts the project-foundry direction
entries.description: The organization defines its enduring purpose around active open work, public Chapters, independent Member Projects, reproducible research, operated services, releases, and attributable contribution records rather than becoming a conventional SaaS portfolio.

entries.title: Lifecycle states and the Open Field identity are made explicit
entries.description: A canonical registry distinguishes active, paused, maintenance, archived, and cancelled work instead of hiding closures. On the same date, Open Field is approved as the shared visual system while product identities and the historical branding repository remain independently traceable.
